summary: Preserve session databases and verify salvage outcomes

delivery.outcome: Correct the four reproduced session-storage failures from merged PR13, pass regression and full product tests, then publish through protected independent validation.
nonGoals: No changes to other repositories or protected review policy
No repair of real user session databases or IDE restart
No deletion of peer worktrees or data

architecture.decision: Keep the existing diagnostic and salvage entry points; use bounded read-only SQLite diagnostics, private exclusive recovery staging and verified publication, and recent bounded log tails.
architecture.rollback: Protected follow-up reverting this implementation; preserve all quarantined source copies.

validation.evidence: Recovery refuses overwrite, validates import and output integrity, preserves source bytes and private quarantine; failures never publish a recovered output.
Locked or inaccessible SQLite inputs produce unavailable/degraded diagnostics, not corruption; recent panic signatures in large logs are detected.

commands: independent Validator exact-head review and merge
validation.evidence: Focused regressions, full suite, actual native X11 fixture and protected gates pass.
